verdict.rationale: Solid's README states that when state changes, only the code that depends on it reruns. This rests on automatic dependency tracking and a render-once component model. Community users independently confirm that fine-grained, granular reactive updates work in real projects, though one notes props must be accessed reactively to keep updating. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party API docs (e.g., signal/effect primitives) in the evidence beyond README-level claims.
